_note: Round 44: time and seasons. The calendar runs on the real date, so the world keeps going while you're away: a season is season_days real days, a year is four seasons. The hour is your own clock (Game.hour). Weather is rolled for each quarter of a day, per place (the surface, or a floor's kind of deep). Every effect uses the same keys as techniques; foe_* keys go to the monsters (Game.level_mod). Words here are Dev's to rewrite (briefs world_seasons, world_weather, festivals).

seasons.name: Thaw
seasons.desc: Spring in the valley. Meltwater runs down into the deep, and everything that grows grows faster.
seasons.tip: Herbs come up thick in the Thaw. It's the season to stock the pouch.

seasons.name: Blaze
seasons.desc: High summer. The forges of the deep run hot and so does your blood.
seasons.tip: In the Blaze you hit harder, and so does everything down there.

seasons.name: Harvest
seasons.desc: Autumn. Traders come down with full carts and the leaves come down with them.
seasons.tip: Harvest is the season for crafting and for selling: luck runs your way.

seasons.name: Frost
seasons.desc: Winter. The valley goes quiet under snow. Quiet is good for sitting.
seasons.tip: Frost slows the beasts and steadies the mind. Sit through the winter and you'll feel it.

night.name: Night
night.desc: The deep is hungrier at night. More of them, and worse -- but they carry more.

dawn.name: Dawn
dawn.desc: The first breath of the day. Qi comes easiest at dawn.

dusk.name: Dusk
dusk.desc: The light turns. Things become clear at dusk: insight comes easier.

rain.name: Rain
rain.desc: Steady rain. The herbs drink it up.

storm.name: Thunderstorm
storm.desc: Thunder over the valley. Lightning in the blood: telling blows land more often.

fog.name: Fog
fog.desc: Thick fog. Your spirit sense reaches further when your eyes can't.

heat.name: Heat haze
heat.desc: Shimmering heat. Fire qi is thick in the air.

snow.name: Snow
snow.desc: Snow falls on Eliet. Everything is muffled and still.

leaves.name: Leaf-fall wind
leaves.desc: A cold wind brings the leaves down.

qi_mist.name: Qi mist
qi_mist.desc: A cool mist of loose qi drifts through the halls. Breathe deep.

spore_drift.name: Spore drift
spore_drift.desc: Spores on the air. They close small wounds -- and feed the things that live here.

ash_fall.name: Ash fall
ash_fall.desc: Ash sifts down from somewhere above. It stings the eyes and dulls the beasts' noses.

cold_seep.name: Cold seep
cold_seep.desc: Cold creeps up through the stone. The beasts move slower; so do you.

tremor.name: Deep tremor
tremor.desc: The rock shivers now and then. Loose stone means loose ore: gathering pays more.

drip.name: Dripping dark
drip.desc: Water drips everywhere. The damp hides your footsteps.

thaw.name: Festival of First Lanterns
thaw.desc: Eliet hangs paper lanterns for everyone who went down and came back. The traders give a little off, and the elder has a gift for those who walk the deep.

blaze.name: Ember Night
blaze.desc: Bonfires in the square, and the smiths show off. A night for blades and bragging.

harvest.name: Harvest Moon
harvest.desc: The whole village eats together under the big moon. The traders' carts are full and the prices are kind.

frost.name: The Longest Night
frost.desc: Candles in every window until dawn, for the ones who didn't come back. A night to sit and remember.

holidays.name: New Year's Day
holidays.desc: Eliet counts down the last night of the year and starts the next one together. A fresh start, they say, is a thing you can pick up with both hands.

holidays.name: Lunar New Year
holidays.desc: Red lanterns, red paper and long tables. The elder hands out little red packets, and the smiths set off cracker-charges for luck.

holidays.name: Hearts' Eve
holidays.desc: Ribbons on every door and small gifts under the lanterns. Even the grumpy ones leave something out.

holidays.name: Clover Day
holidays.desc: Green ribbons and a very loud band. The traders say a clover found today is worth a gold piece, though they say a lot of things.

holidays.name: Spring Awakening
holidays.desc: Painted eggs hidden around the village and a basket for every child. The first new green of the year is blessed at dawn.

holidays.name: Day of Green Hands
holidays.desc: The village plants a tree for every herb it has pulled up this year. The herbalists show off.

holidays.name: Fireworks Night
holidays.desc: The smiths pack the sky with sparks and the whole valley sits on the hillside to watch. Loud, bright, and good for the spirits.

holidays.name: Hollow Night
holidays.desc: Carved gourds on every step, and the dead are welcome for the night. The traders hand out sweets, and the children are not to be trusted.

holidays.name: Festival of a Thousand Lamps
holidays.desc: A thousand small lamps along every road and every sill. Sweets pass from hand to hand, and nothing is allowed to stay dark.

holidays.name: Harvest Table
holidays.desc: Every house sets out a plate for whoever walks past. The Harvest Table runs the length of the square, and no one counts the portions.

holidays.name: Midwinter Gifts
holidays.desc: Evergreen boughs in every window, one gift for everyone in the village, and a long quiet supper. Even the deep feels a little less cold.

holidays.name: Year's End
holidays.desc: Counting the year's good and bad. Bells at midnight, and a toast for everyone who did not make it home.

world_holidays.name: Founders' Day
world_holidays.desc: Eliet remembers the first expedition and the first fire. Every house puts a lantern in the window for the ones who went down first.

world_holidays.name: Root-Dawn
world_holidays.desc: At first light the herbalists lay the season's first harvest on the stones. Everything that grows grows a little better today.

world_holidays.name: The Forge Feast
world_holidays.desc: The smiths open the forges to everyone. Anyone can hammer a nail and be called a smith for the day.

world_holidays.name: Tower Vigil
world_holidays.desc: The sects light beacons on every tower, and the valley stays awake to watch them burn. A night for climbers.

world_holidays.name: Gleaning Day
world_holidays.desc: The fields are open to anyone who will carry a basket. The leavings are always the best of it.

world_holidays.name: The Lamp Walk
world_holidays.desc: A slow procession from the village to the first stair, a lamp in every hand. They leave the lamps at the top, to light the way down.

world_holidays.name: First Snow
world_holidays.desc: Children out in the street before dawn to meet it. The traders hand out hot drinks.

world_holidays.name: Night of Rest
world_holidays.desc: Everything shuts, even the forges. The valley sleeps on purpose, and the old say that dreams are clearest tonight.
